summary.title: Create a Twitter Bot in Python Using Tweepy
summary.one_liner: You learn how to authenticate with the Twitter API via Tweepy and build a Python bot that follows followers, retweets/favorites tweets, and replies by keyword, with a Tkinter GUI to drive it.
keywords: how to make a twitter bot in python
takeaways: Install Tweepy with pip and authenticate using Consumer Key/Secret and Access Token/Secret from the Twitter developer app.
Follow followers, and search by keyword with tweepy.Cursor to retweet or favorite matching tweets.
Reply to users found in a keyword search by using update_status with in_reply_to_status_id.
Wrap the bot logic in a function and wire it to a Tkinter GUI with entry fields and a submit button.
summary.summary: The author explains why they built a Twitter bot after finding a web app that only supported one action per bot. The tutorial covers installing Tweepy, storing API credentials, and authenticating with OAuthHandler. It then builds the bot step by step: following followers, searching by keyword to retweet, favorite, or reply, and handling TweepError. Finally, it adds a Tkinter GUI whose inputs and checkboxes-as-yes/no entries control which actions run.
